python3 -B - <<'PY'
import http.client,json,pathlib,subprocess,sys
want="3fcff1fb78abadb52cdbc85679ab4ad3641aa9e1"
key=(pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"tgtumbler"/"tumblr-operation-app"/"tumblr-app-access-token").read_text().strip()
def need(ok,k):
 print(k+"="+("PASS" if ok else "FAIL"),flush=True)
 if not ok:sys.exit(42)
def send(path,payload=None):
 c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
 try:
  c.request("POST" if payload is not None else "GET",path,
    json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else None,
    headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+key,"Content-Type":"application/json"})
  r=c.getresponse()
  return r.status,r.read(240000)
 finally:c.close()
head=subprocess.run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=8).stdout.strip()
need(head==want,"GIT_HEAD_EXACT")
st,body=send("/healthz")
need(st==200 and json.loads(body).get("commit")==want,"LIVE_APP_SHA")
st,body=send("/assistant",{"selected_action":"analytics.get_summary","selected_target":"week"})
res=json.loads(body) if st==200 else {}
view=res.get("view",{})
labels=[r.get("label") for r in view.get("rows",[])]
need(st==200 and res.get("state")=="completed" and res.get("executed") is True,
     "ANALYTICS_ADAPTER_CONNECTED")
need(all(x in labels for x in ("本アプリから確認済みのいいね操作数",
   "本アプリから確認済みのリブログ操作数",
   "本アプリから確認済みのフォロー操作数")),"ENGAGEMENT_ACTUAL_METRICS_INCLUDED")
need(all(str(r.get("value","")).isdigit() for r in view.get("rows",[])
         if r.get("label") in labels[-3:]),"ENGAGEMENT_METRIC_VALUES_NUMERIC")
for suite in ("test_analytics_runtime.py","test_engagement_runtime.py"):
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B","-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p",suite,"-q"],
                   capture_output=True,timeout=45)
 need(p.returncode==0,"PRODUCTION_OFFLINE_"+suite)
print("PROVIDER_OPERATIONS=ZERO",flush=True)
print("ACCEPTANCE=PASS",flush=True)
PY
